evidence.note: isConnecting is derived as status==='connecting'; isConnected is status==='connected' (use-scribe.ts:371). Combined-true is unrepresentable in the upstream ScribeStatus.
Icon branches pair !isConnecting && isConnected vs !isConnecting && !isConnected; never handles both-true.

notes: idle|connecting|connected already exists as ScribeStatus; context flattens it back into two bits.

disqualifier.note: Independent axes: sendDisabled is a content/policy gate; streaming is an in-flight turn. Combined-true is legal (Stop shown while send would be disabled).
Inline Effect FileSystem remove options at the atomic-write cleanup call; force and recursive are independent platform-fs SDK knobs, and this call sets both true.
CustomEventInit flags on the desktop watch-request event. bubbles/cancelable/composed are independent DOM EventInit axes; all eight combinations are legal EventInit values.
